control_variants.free: one unrestricted symmetric in-plane Ainv tensor (3 DoFs) per muscle triangle
control_variants.tied: fine muscle triangles tied to a fixed physical coarse-triangle partition

geometry.fixed: bottom, left, and right; both in-plane components

inverse.forward: damped Newton with Armijo line search and exact sparse tangent
inverse.gradient: exact implicit adjoint H p=-dL/du; dL/da=(dr/da)^T p
inverse.physical_comparison_state: minimum objective among orientation-preserving, strictly equilibrated evaluations before the first orientation failure

loss: mean squared residual after embedding each 2D top displacement as (ux,uy,0)
scope: Self-contained 2D triangle implementation of the exact plane-strain restriction of Apple's StableNeoHookean and StableNeoHookeanActive energies. It matches nonlinear-equilibrium and implicit-adjoint inverse semantics, but is not executed through Apple's tetrahedron-only Warp FEM.

solver_diagnostics.interpretation: False values identify near-singular or inverted transition evaluations; they do not invalidate the separately verified comparison states.

tangent_identifiability.scope: local tangent at undeformed zero-activation equilibrium; this is an identifiability certificate, not a global nonlinear unreachability proof
